build_train_dataset: build a training dataset for visual correspondence QA by sampling image pairs and generating annotated multichoice samples
build_val_dataset: build a validation dataset for visual correspondence QA from camera overlap parquet files with multichoice annotations
build_training_sample: build a single visual correspondence training sample with annotated images and multichoice question answer pairs
sample_dataframe: sample a DataFrame by overlap bins distributing quota evenly across bins with leftover carryover mechanism
convert_parquet_to_dict: convert a parquet DataFrame with key and value columns back into a Python dictionary
